prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1385
Claimant:
Sean Padilla
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
November 12, 2024
Claim received for a collision during a left turn at an intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck by an oncmoing
vehicle, and the claimant reports neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact
will be routed through the attorney's office.
December 2, 2024
Reviewed the policy and confiremd the driver involved is listed as a named driver with coverage in force on the loss
date. Nothing in the file points to any gap or lapse in coverage at the time of the incident.
December 8, 2024
Police report obtained. Responding officers document that the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene, and
the statements of both drivers are rceorded in the report.
February 13, 2025
Photographs taken at the scene and of the vehicles were reviewed. The damage pattern on the vehicle is consistent
with the impact described, including the point of contact and direction of force.
February 21, 2025
Spoke with the claimant through counsel regarding the injury. The reported neck and back strain fits the kind and
force expected from a broadside impact of this type. No prior injury to the same body areas is known from available
records.
March 1, 2025
No independent witnesses were identified in the police report or in follow-up inquiries. Scene photographs confirm
some details of positioning and damage but do not capture the moment of impact.
March 6, 2025
Obtained recorded statement details from the claimant. The account of how the collision occurred matches what was
given at the scene and in prior conversations with the adjuster.
April 16, 2025
Treatment records received show initial care followed by a steadily growing number of visits and additional services
added over successive months. The volume of care is well above what is typically needed for a strain of this nature,
and the file is flagged for medical review.
May 2, 2025
Vehicle inspection completed. No earlier damage to the vehicle's affected area appears in prior claims history or
inspection notes.
May 7, 2025
Requested an updated medical review and itemized billing from the treating providers. Reviewing the escaltaing
treatment pattern against typical recovery timelines for this injury.
May 9, 2025
File remains open pending the medical review and receipt of itemized billing. Next action is a reserve review once the
treating provider documentation is complete.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
